method: Blind AI visual transcription from uncropped original 1920x1080 gameplay frames. First inspected all four supplied frames, then decoded original clip frames at offsets 7, 11 and 12 seconds with ffmpeg only. Own HP/resource/level/cooldowns come from bottom player HUD; own K/D/A, CS and game clock come from native top-right HUD. Top-left selected-target panel, external right statistics overlay and external minimap timers were excluded. No operator reference, expected-answer lock, HF join, State or Coach judgment was read or used.

uncertainties: A null cooldown means no readable numeric cooldown in this frame; it does not assert ability readiness.

sequence_observations.observation: Tristana (Qertoss336) is on the right side of the visible opposing minion groups, beside the right lane brush at 0.1s. Miss Fortune (Zr3sY01) is to the left among the minions. Blue-team champion DarknessKiller000 is above the minion line at 0.1s and beside Miss Fortune at 5s. Tristana remains to their right at 5s. The ally health bar at 5s is almost empty.

At 7s Tristana and the red-outlined Miss Fortune are adjacent in the lane while DarknessKiller000 has moved up/right toward the trees. A green +240 number appears over Miss Fortune. Blue caster minions remain to Tristana’s right; blue cannon/melee minions are below-left, and a red cannon minion is below-right. Q displays 17 at 5s and 15 at 7s.

At 10s Tristana is below-left of Miss Fortune near the tree edge; a projectile/impact trail lies between them. An orange circular ground effect covers Tristana and nearby minions. DarknessKiller000’s model is prone next to Miss Fortune, and the native kill banner/chat shows Miss Fortune killed that ally. Tristana’s displayed HP is 950 / 1344 at 10s.

At 11s Tristana is airborne with an orange exhaust/landing trail, above-left of Miss Fortune beside the tree edge. W now displays 20. The selected red-outlined Miss Fortune is immediately below-right of Tristana; damage numbers and projectiles are visible around both. Tristana’s bottom HUD reads 590 / 1347 HP at this sample.

At 12s the native shutdown banner shows Tristana and Miss Fortune, +900 is visible near Tristana, own K/D/A changes to 2/3/0, and own level becomes 10. By 14s both nearby champion models are prone, Tristana is among surviving blue minions, a +90 number is visible above a red cannon minion, and own CS reads 58. A green movement marker is visible farther down/right on the lane at 14s; the next movement is outside this sample.

unresolved_areas: Sparse frames do not establish the complete attack/ability order, exact target of every projectile, or precise time of events between samples.
The initial and later displayed maximum HP/resource values differ; these were transcribed as shown without inferring a mechanic behind the changes.
No pixel-to-world range, safety margin, unseen-enemy position, player intention, psychological state, or quality judgment is established.
W at 12s is obscured by level-up effects; other null ability displays contain no readable numeric cooldown and have not been converted into readiness claims.
